description: Laboratory Data Ontologist Remote | Canada or US Overview We are seeking a Laboratory Data Ontologist to strengthen the semantic foundation of our platform and the client-specific ontologies deployed on top of it. Labbit is built on a typed entity graph — samples, containers, locations, instruments, pools, and their provenance — and every implementation is, at its core, a modelling exercise: mapping a client's scientific and operational vocabulary onto that graph without losing fidelity. This role sits within our Advisory group. You will spend ~50% of your time billable on client implementation projects as the modelling lead, and the remaining ~50% on internal stewardship — evolving the core ontology, codifying modelling practice, and supporting Sales pursuits. This is not a data engineer role and not a solutions architect role. You are a modeller, steeped in information theory, taxonomy design, and ontology engineering — whose primary deliverables are client and platform ontologies, reference models, and the standards that govern them. Why This Role Matters Our platform's differentiator is a configurable, versioned entity graph with immutable lineage. That model is only as valuable as the discipline behind it: Advisory engagements deepen when modelling is treated as a first-class deliverable rather than a byproduct of configuration. Sales wins when we can quickly show a prospect their world represented cleanly in our model. Implementation delivers faster when client vocabulary maps to reusable patterns instead of bespoke types. Platform evolves coherently when extensions across clients are legible as variants of shared abstractions rather than divergent one-offs. Housing this role in Advisory keeps the practitioner close to real client problems — the billable work is where modelling craft is sharpened — while the non-billable half compounds those learnings into shared assets the whole company draws on. What You Will Do 1. Lead Modelling on Client Engagements (~50% billable) Serve as the modelling lead on Advisory and Implementation engagements where ontology depth is the critical risk Run discovery sessions to elicit and structure client domain models Produce target ontologies — entity types, controlled vocabularies, field taxonomies, workflow decompositions — as billable deliverables Review changeset designs for modelling quality alongside implementation engineers Coach client counterparts on stewardship of their own model post go-live 2. Steward the Core Ontology Own the conceptual model behind Labbit's base entity types (@Sample, @Container, @Location, @Instrument, @Reagent, @Pool) and their inheritance semantics Maintain design principles for when to extend a base type vs. introduce a new one Review proposed changes to the base ontology for coherence, minimalism, and long-term extensibility Curate the shared reference/IRI namespace so aliases remain meaningful across changesets and clients 3. Codify Modelling Practice Across Advisory Author internal standards for taxonomy design, controlled vocabulary governance, and ontology versioning Identify reusable extension patterns across client engagements and promote them into shared libraries Establish review rituals so modelling decisions are traceable and reversible Train Advisory and Implementation staff in applied ontology techniques Build a shared library of domain reference models for our priority verticals (QC manufacturing, clinical genomics, CGT, stability) 4. Support Sales Join late-stage sales cycles to lead ontology discovery sessions with prospects Produce lightweight target models that demonstrate fit without over-committing to configuration Translate prospect terminology (assays, panels, batches, lots) into our model in real time during demos 5. Inform Platform Direction Surface modelling gaps discovered across client work as candidate platform investments Advise Platform Engineering on schema evolution semantics (changeset migrations, deprecations, aliasing) Contribute to decisions about first-class vs. reference-data entities, computed fields, and graph traversal features What You Will Not Do Own application development or feature delivery Serve as project manager or delivery lead on client engagements Replace implementation configuration engineers or platform engineers Build a parallel modelling framework outside our changeset system Qualifications Required Strong grounding in information theory, formal ontology, or knowledge representation (academic or applied) 5+ years working with structured domain models — taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, ontologies, or graph schemas — in production settings Fluency with at least one modelling formalism (OWL/RDF, property graphs, UML class models, ISA-Tab, or comparable) Demonstrated ability to elicit domain knowledge from subject-matter experts and translate it into a coherent model Comfort in a client-facing, billable advisory context — including scoping deliverables, running workshops, and defending modelling decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders Comfort reading and reasoning about configuration-as-code artifacts (JSON schemas, BPMN, expression languages) Excellent written communication — you will produce reference models, standards, and documentation that others rely on Strongly Preferred Experience in laboratory informatics, life sciences, or another regulated scientific domain (QC manufacturing, genomics, clinical diagnostics, CGT) Familiarity with LIMS, ELN, or scientific workflow platforms and their data models Experience with versioned schema evolution and immutable/provenance data models Exposure to regulated environments (21 CFR Part 11, GAMP5) and their implications for schema governance Prior consulting or professional services experience with utilization targets To further support our team, we offer the following benefits: Competitive vacation Flexible health spending account / Health Insurance RRSP description: Standard Job Description The Data and AI Enablement organization is seeking an Enterprise Ontology Product Owner to serve as the connective role between the business functions that own enterprise ontologies and the technical teams that build them. This person ensures that ontology models are grounded in real business meaning, validated by the people who use them, and adopted across AI-enabled experiences, analytics tools, and data products. This is not a technical modeling role. There are dedicated technical teams responsible for building and maintaining ontologies. Instead, this role requires someone who can operate fluently across business functions, translate business language and logic into requirements the technical team can act on, and hold the line on quality, consistency, and adoption. Success depends on deep functional domain expertise, strong facilitation skills, and enough technical fluency to be a credible partner to data engineering and AI/ML teams, not on the ability to build ontologies directly. What You’ll Do Validate and prioritize ontology use cases – ensure models align with business goals, governance policies, and real‑world terminology while coaching business functions to develop competency questions that test scope and correctness. Translate business intent into clear, engineer‑ready requirements and bring stakeholders in as co‑creators through workshops, so data‑engineering and AI/ML teams can build efficiently and without duplication. Collaborate with data product owners and platform teams to guarantee that ontology‑driven data products integrate smoothly with the broader data‑product ecosystem, avoiding conflicts or redundant effort. Drive delivery and quality assurance – track progress, remove blockers, enforce production‑grade data‑pipeline controls, and evaluate the quality and business value of engineered outputs before stakeholder hand‑off. Communicate value and promote adoption – explain modeling decisions in plain language, showcase possibilities with generative‑AI tools, and champion the product to senior leadership and end users. Maintain a continuous feedback loop – gather ongoing stakeholder input, iterate on ontology scope, and update success metrics (adoption, usage, consistency, AI answer quality, business impact) to demonstrate measurable value. Lead cross‑functional delivery teams and partner with business function owners to clarify RACI responsibilities while owning the overall process, coordination, and quality of the ontology. Basic Qualifications Experience working with or on ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models in a professional capacity. Proven ability to partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into structured documentation or models. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of explaining technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. What Success Looks Like You’ll know you are successful when business functions trust the ontology as an accurate reflection of how they define their own data and processes, technical teams receive clear, validated requirements to build against, and adoption of ontology‑driven capabilities grows measurably across AI‑enabled experiences, analytics tools, and data products. Success is demonstrated by high usage metrics, concrete business impact, and a continuous cycle of stakeholder‑driven evolution of the product. Must be a U.S. citizen. Basic Qualifications • Experience working with or on ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models in some professional capacity • Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into structured documentation or models • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to explain technical or structured concepts to non-technical audiences Desired Skills Deep functional domain expertise in one or more enterprise areas (e.g., finance, supply chain, sales, HR, product). Background in product ownership, business analysis, or a coordination‑heavy role focused on validation of use cases. Experience with enterprise data products, platforms, and pipelines (Databricks, data warehouses, MDM, etc.). Experience with data governance, metadata management, or master‑data programs. Familiarity with AI‑enabled experiences, analytics tools, and the broader data‑product ecosystem. Ability to facilitate workshops and engage stakeholders as co‑creators. Understanding of how ontologies improve AI answer quality, semantic search/discovery, and overall business value. Experience with large‑scale enterprise systems (SAP, ERP, etc.) to anchor business terminology in operational data. We are evolving an advanced, AI-powered knowledge graph into a reliable, scalable platform that enables teams across Reddit to build better experiences on top of shared, high-quality knowledge. This is a high-leverage team at the intersection of data, platform engineering, and AI. Our work supports emerging capabilities such as contextual grounding while creating the contracts, standards, and developer experience that make shared data dependable and easy to use. description: Clinical Analytics Specialist – MD Are you a licensed MD looking to help drive innovation within our global organization? About the role. We are looking for an MD to serve as our Clinical Analytics Specialist to join the Data Discovery and Enrichment Team (DDE). The Clinical Analytics Specialist will provide support for clinical decision support (CDS) product development to improve the search and discovery experience for users of products such as ClinicalKey at the point-of-care. You will have a critical role in working with the Clinical Solutions and Education business units to provide clinical analytics support and drive growth, revenue generation, and innovation. About the team. This team is entrusted with the validation of extracted medical information from Elsevier corpus and electronic health care records, information retrieval, creating data for gold set generation, and participating in content enrichment workflows aiding in clinical decision support. Experience Clinical degree required (MD, MBBS,GP) Preference given to those with formal training or significant experience in evidence-based medicine, clinical research, epidemiology, biostatistics, and the application of evidence to practice. Experience in semantic technologies, including text mining, ontology management is a plus. Excellent command of the English language in both spoken and written forms is required and some level of proficiency with another language is a plus. Experience with medical vocabularies such as SNOMED CT and ICD-10 is beneficial, as is knowledge of ontology modeling. Extensive computer skill competency. Proficiency in a Microsoft Windows environment; and strong MS Word/Powerpoint skills and ability to work with templates using an electronic content management system. Visualization and dashboarding skills (e.g. using Tableau) is a plus. Demonstrated problem-solving ability, sense of urgency, and ability to prioritize tasks, to work simultaneously on multiple projects, and to ensure completion of editorial team projects per tight timelines. The Clinical Analytics Specialist should be a clinician (MD, MBBS or GP) with experience in informatics and knowledge retrieval Able to work with a variety of stakeholders at the mid and senior management level Responsibilities Appling clinical knowledge to extract and integrate data in a healthcare environment. Adapting domain ontologies for information extraction, data modeling and analysis. Working closely with data scientists, clinicians, subject matter experts (SMEs), taxonomists, and data analysts to provide insights used in automation and applications for our businesses in health markets Working on the modeling, validation, and maintenance of core extracted clinical relationships to deliver an evidence-based and development of Elsevier’s healthcare knowledge graph (H-graph). Providing insight for ensuring high quality of automated indexing for search & discovery. Appling own domain knowledge and work with external clinical experts to confirm and validate clinical accuracy of content. Ensure that content is clinically accurate, current, and supported by the best available evidence from the medical literature, current guidelines, and accepted performance standards. Building domain specific training data sets for machine learning (ML) models used in Point-of-care products Predictive analytics and insights from combining big datasets in healthcare Participating in design, prototyping, and analytics in their day to day providing insights for algorithm codification that will improve clinical workflows and content creation. Elsevier is a renowned global information analytics company that primarily focuses on providing scientific, technical, and medical (STM) research content, tools, and services. It is one of the largest publishers of academic journals and scholarly literature in the world. Elsevier operates in various domains, including science, technology, medicine, social sciences, and more. They publish a vast number of peer-reviewed journals covering a wide range of disciplines. These journals act as platforms for researchers and academics to share their findings and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields. In addition to publishing, Elsevier offers a suite of digital solutions and services to support researchers, scientists, and professionals in their work. They provide online platforms like ScienceDirect, Scopus, and Mendeley, which offer access to a vast repository of scholarly articles, research papers, and other scientific content. These platforms often serve as essential resources for software developers seeking to stay updated with the latest scientific advancements. Furthermore, Elsevier offers tools and services to help researchers with tasks such as data management, article submission, and citation tracking. They also provide metrics and analytics to assess the impact and reach of scientific publications. Additionally, Elsevier hosts conferences and events to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration within the scientific community. U.S. National Base Pay Range: $78,800 - $131,300. description: About airSlate airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - SignNow, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work. We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines. At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment. We are looking for a hands-on leader to run Data Enablement. The team that owns how our data is modeled, trusted, and made ready for the business and for AI. You will lead analytics engineers and web analytics specialists, own the semantic layer end-to-end, and turn raw product and event data into curated, well-documented datasets that people can rely on. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Lead and grow the team. Set priorities, coach, and keep a steady delivery rhythm across analytics engineering and web analytics. Own the semantic layer. Design, build and evolve SQL-based models and metric definitions so that one number means one thing across all our products. Raise data curation and automate the routine. Move the team from ad hoc requests to reusable, tested, documented datasets that people and our AI data assistant can query directly, with tracking checks and data-quality monitoring on autopilot. Set standards and partner across the data organization. Modeling conventions, version control, testing and release practices, code review; work with Data Business Partners, Data Science / ML and Data Platform on scope and ownership. Stay close to the code on critical builds. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: Experience. 5+ years in analytics, data or BI engineering, including 2+ years leading a team or leading others technically. Expert SQL and Python. You set query and performance standards others follow, rewrite expensive queries and explain the trade-offs, handle incremental loads, deduplication and slowly changing dimensions, and own production Python components that other teams depend on. Data modeling and pipelines. You design warehouse and mart models that several teams build on, including a semantic layer, and choose the methodology (star schema, Data Vault or equivalent) to fit the queries it must serve. You optimize and troubleshoot pipelines on a cloud stack such as AWS (Athena, Redshift, Glue) and orchestration tools such as Airflow. Engineering discipline. You set branching and code review standards, require schema and data tests and CI before release, and lead risky changes with a clear rollout and rollback plan. Data quality and data fluency. You design validation that catches problems before stakeholders do, fix root causes rather than symptoms, set documentation standards, and investigate unfamiliar sources before trusting them. Business impact. You design solution options for complex problems, split cross-team work into pieces with a clear definition of done, build dashboards around the decision they support, and become a trusted partner to business leaders. AI in everyday work. You redesign team workflows around AI tools to drive adoption, and evaluate AI outputs for quality, privacy and bias. Leadership and ownership. You own complex team-level projects, make high-impact decisions from complex information, coach people by spotting skill gaps and giving regular feedback, set clear scope expectations, and turn change into actionable steps for the team. Communication. You clarify complex ideas, build consensus across teams and time zones, and communicate in fluent English. Nice to have: experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework (we may adopt one); web analytics and tracking (GTM, GA4); B2B SaaS or document-workflow / e-signature background. What we offer Flexible working environment - Our teams operate across the globe. We value in‑person collaboration in our hubs, but we also embrace remote and hybrid working. You can work from one of our offices in the United States, Poland, Romania or Ukraine, or remotely from many countries. Competitive compensation and stock options - We offer salaries that reflect local market conditions and experience, plus a performance-based bonus system and stock options so you share in the company’s growth. Professional growth and learning - We invest in your development through courses, conferences, and access to learning resources. We encourage career growth and internal mobility, supporting teammates who want to explore new opportunities within airSlate. Health and well‑being - We provide comprehensive benefits tailored to each country, including health coverage, wellness programmes and access to fitness options. We also dedicate quarterly company-wide Mental Health Days, when everyone takes time off to rest and recharge. Family‑friendly culture - Family life is part of who we are, and we embrace it in many forms. From flexibility for parents to our airSlate Junior Club for kids, to company-wide family days and our pet-friendly approach, we’re committed to making work and life easier to balance. Giving back - We support charitable initiatives around the world through the airSlate Care programme. Our current focus includes humanitarian aid in Ukraine and other regions, matching employee donations and supporting causes chosen by our teams. Open communication - We encourage transparent dialogue at all levels. From team discussions to company-wide Q&A sessions with our CEO, we make sure everyone has the chance to be heard and to influence how we grow. description: Dir & Data Engineer - GE06BE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The Principal Ontologist and Graph Modeler is responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing enterprise semantic models, ontologies, and knowledge representations that provide meaning, context, and explainability for AI-driven analytics, agentic systems, and decision automation across the Business Insurance data portfolio. This role ensures that Business Insurance concepts, entities, relationships, metrics, rules, and behaviors are explicitly modeled and consistently applied across data products and AI systems. The role enables reuse, trust, reasoning, semantic interoperability, and scalable AI adoption across underwriting, policy, claims, distribution, customer, product, and portfolio domains. Operating at the intersection of business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, this role translates complex insurance domain knowledge into production-ready semantic assets that are consumable by both humans and machines. Job Responsibilities: Lead the design and execution of enterprise-scale semantic layers for the Business Insurance data portfolio to standardize business meaning and enable trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases. Define and operationalize ontologies, context graphs, and knowledge graphs across Business Insurance domains to power reasoning, explainability, and decision intelligence. Model core insurance concepts and relationships spanning customers, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance. Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics by ensuring large language models and agents can consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships. Define canonical semantic vocabularies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured Business Insurance data sources. Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, governance, security, and lifecycle management. Define and promote standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, and ontology reuse across delivery teams. Partner with Business Insurance data product owners, domain leaders, architects, and engineers to embed semantic models into data products, AI pipelines, analytics, and activation layers. Work closely with AI Data Architects and AI Data Engineers to operationalize ontologies through graphs, metadata services, APIs, and production data platforms. Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards. Enable explainability by ensuring AI and analytical outputs can be traced to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data. Serve as the principal authority for semantic engineering, ontology, and graph-modeling practices supporting the Business Insurance data portfolio. Advance agentic data engineering through reference patterns, playbooks, proofs of value, and production deployments. Contribute to communities of practice, reference guidance, reusable assets, and internal enablement materials. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience with large scale data warehouses data. 8–12+ years of hands-on experience in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale. Deep, hands-on expertise with RDF, OWL (OWL 2), RDFS, SKOS, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards. Proven experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs and governed semantic assets. Hands-on experience with graph or triple-store technologies such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or Spanner Graph. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks. Strong understanding of AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability. Experience integrating semantic layers with data platforms, APIs, metadata systems, analytics platforms, and AI pipelines. Ability to translate complex insurance domain knowledge into formal, machine-readable semantic and graph structures. Strong understanding of context-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, and semantic interoperability. Proven ability to move from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise capability. Strong executive influence and thought leadership in semantic engineering, agentic analytics, and AI-native data engineering. Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, and Snowflake. Business Insurance domain knowledge across one or more areas such as underwriting, policy, claims, distribution, product, customer, or portfolio management. description: Signicatis a pan-European digital identity company that makes it easy and safe for organisations to know who they are interacting with online. Using our proprietary technology, we help companies and public organisations securely verify the identities of people and businesses, authenticate users, and enable compliant electronic document signing, so their customers can access services and complete online processes with confidence. Today, Signicat employs over 530 people across 20 offices in 15 European countries. We work with leading banks, fintechs, telcos, public authorities, healthcare providers, and enterprises across retail and mobility to deliver trusted digital identity and onboarding solutions at scale. Joining Signicat means contributing to a mission that has a real impact on how society works and trusting each other in an increasingly digital world. About the Role Imagine a software development environment where AI agents can collaborate, plan complex tasks, write code, run tests, and help engineers turn ideas into working software. That's what we're building. As a Platform Engineer in Signicat's AI Foundations team, you'll help design and build our internal AI Software Factory: a platform that enables teams of autonomous AI agents to work together, interact securely with our systems, and accelerate how we build software. This isn't just about integrating LLM APIs. We're building the foundations for agent-driven software engineering, tackling challenges around orchestration, distributed execution, state management, sandboxing, security, and human-agent collaboration. Our platform runs on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes, with Go as our primary programming language. You'll join a team exploring the boundaries of what's possible with AI agents, combining experimentation with solid software engineering principles to turn ambitious ideas into reliable, production-ready systems. How You'll Make An Impact Build the AI Software Factory: Design and develop the core services, APIs, and infrastructure that enable AI agents to plan, execute, and collaborate on complex software engineering tasks. Orchestrate intelligent agents: Build systems that coordinate multiple specialized agents, manage dependencies, schedule work, and support long-running, asynchronous workflows. Design reliable agent runtimes: Develop secure, stateful execution environments that manage agent lifecycles, context, tool invocations, retries, recovery, and execution isolation. Make autonomous execution safe: Implement sandboxing, fine-grained permissions, and security boundaries that allow agents to interact with code, tools, and internal systems without compromising security. Connect agents to the real world: Integrate LLMs, development workflows, internal APIs, and external tools through secure, extensible interfaces and emerging standards such as MCP and A2A. Enable human-agent collaboration: Help create systems where engineers can guide, supervise, and collaborate with autonomous agents, maintaining control over important decisions. Shape the future of AI engineering: Evaluate emerging technologies, challenge existing approaches, experiment with new architectural patterns, and help define how autonomous software engineering evolves at Signicat. Solve interesting engineering problems: Apply your understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, and software architecture to challenges that don't always have established solutions. Why We'll Love You You have strong software engineering experience, ideally with Go, and enjoy building robust backend services, APIs, and distributed systems. You're comfortable working with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure, ideally on Google Cloud Platform. You think beyond individual services and understand how to design systems that handle concurrency, failures, asynchronous execution, and complex state transitions. You care about clean architecture, well-designed APIs, maintainable code, and automated testing. You understand the importance of security, particularly around authentication, authorization, isolation, and executing untrusted workloads. You're curious about LLMs and autonomous agents, including concepts such as tool calling, context management, multi-agent collaboration, and agent orchestration. You enjoy exploring emerging technologies, experimenting with new approaches, and turning promising ideas into practical solutions. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of challenging technical problems, and helping shape architectural decisions. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and challenging assumptions to find better solutions. Bonus Points You've built systems using agent frameworks such as Google ADK, or worked with protocols like MCP or A2A. You have experience with sandboxing or workload isolation technologies such as gVisor, WebAssembly, or container-based execution environments. You've worked with event-driven architectures, workflow engines, distributed schedulers, or systems supporting long-running processes. You've experimented with AI coding agents, autonomous development workflows, or multi-agent systems. You have experience designing secure integrations with external services, including OAuth and delegated authorization. You've explored graph-based architectures, RDF, SPARQL, or event-driven systems, and are excited about using these concepts to model complex relationships, agent workflows, and dynamic, reactive applications. This is a wish list, not a checklist. You don't need to have worked with every technology or built AI agents before. If you're a strong engineer who loves solving complex problems and is excited about shaping the future of AI-driven software development, we'd love to hear from you. What we offer: Tailored benefits package by location - we aim to empower our employees by offering customised benefits suited to each market Your tech, your way - choose the tech gear that aligns with your comfort and meets your preferences Remote work style -while you embrace a remote environment, we support occasional in-person gatherings to strengthen the teamwork Work-life balance - enjoy an extra 5 paid days off annually, and we make sure to celebrate your work anniversaries to acknowledge the milestones you achieve Health & Wellness - we prioritise your physical and mental well-being by providing designated packs and access to the Headspace app Continuous growth - quarterly development talks, a dedicated time during working hours each week for training and development, access to Udemy courses, defined career paths, and internal mentorship opportunities Customised onboarding - we will prepare an Onboarding Plan to ensure an easy and smooth beginning Be part of an international team - the opportunity to work from any other Signicat office for 2 months per year and 3 weeks per year from any EU country Empowering feedback culture - by using employee engagement tools, we ensure that every voice is heard, empowering us to grow together Meet-ups - frequent office gatherings and biennial Kick-off event to bring every Signicat under one roof that you don’t want to miss Salary: €70,000-€90,000 gross yearly. We are open to discussing the salary based on your skills and competencies. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About Schema App Schema App is a fast-growing, profitable SaaS company headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, with a team across Canada. We're a smart, collaborative group driven by a shared mission: to become a global leader in enterprise marketing technology and help organizations future-proof for the age of AI. We work with some of the world's most recognized enterprises, including SAP, Wells Fargo, and Henry Ford Health, to give them control over how their brand is understood and represented by AI across search and digital experiences. At our core, we believe that in the age of AI, a brand is only as strong as the data behind it and the connections within it. As search evolves into AI-driven and agent-led experiences, that foundation becomes critical. That's why we're building the infrastructure enterprises need to control how they show up in AI today and compete in the agentic web tomorrow: driving growth, protecting their brand, and leading in the next generation of digital experiences. Our platform helps enterprises build and govern the semantic data layer that search engines, AI and agents rely on: deploying Schema Markup and entity linking at scale, turning content into a governed Content Knowledge Graph, and activating that data across AI experiences, including Knowledge Assistant, our grounded, cited answer experience powered by NLWeb. Visit Schema App at or on LinkedIn. The role We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to own product strategy for a major part of Schema App's platform and to raise the bar for how we build products as a team. This is a senior individual-contributor leadership role. You'll set multi-quarter direction for a product line, make the hard trade-offs explicit, and turn strategy into shipped outcomes in partnership with Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success. You'll also be a multiplier: coaching and mentoring the product managers around you, including a PM-in-training, and helping shape the product frameworks and practices our team uses every day. We're looking for an experienced, well-rounded product leader with deep B2B SaaS experience, comfortable in a startup through scale-up environment, who is energized by how AI search and agentic experiences are reshaping how brands are found and chosen. If that sounds like you, show us in your application. This role reports to Mark van Berkel, COO and co-founder. What you'll do Own product strategy across quarters: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy and roadmap for a product line, connecting market shifts in AI search, answer engines and agents to clear product bets, and grounding trade-offs in usage data, customer feedback and business impact. Lead platform, API and packaging decisions: Shape how our platform, integrations and APIs are designed and exposed to customers and partners, and partner with leadership on pricing and packaging so that what we build is easy to buy, adopt and expand. Coach PMs and raise how we build: Raise the craft of the product team through regular coaching, feedback and modelling, including mentoring a PM-in-training, and partner with the Product Community of Practice to evolve our roadmap, prioritization and go-to-market (GTM) frameworks, keeping them lightweight and practical. Be a trusted presence with enterprise customers: Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects, represent the roadmap in executive and customer conversations, and bring first-hand customer evidence back into strategy and prioritization. Drive go-to-market outcomes: Partner with Marketing and Customer Success on positioning, launches, Sales and CSM enablement, and adoption tracking. Lead with AI and agent fluency: Use AI copilots and agentic tools to work faster, with clear judgment about what to verify versus trust, and bring a strong point of view on how AI answer engines and agents retrieve and act on structured content. What you bring (must-haves) 8+ years as a product manager, with deep hands-on experience in B2B SaaS. Ownership of a product line or product strategy across several quarters, with clear evidence of shipped outcomes and measurable impact (adoption, retention, revenue), not just responsibilities. A track record of coaching and mentoring product managers, including helping a more junior or early-career PM grow their craft. Pricing and packaging, or platform/API product experience: you've shaped how a product is packaged and monetized, or owned a platform, integration or API product used by customers or partners. Executive presence with enterprise customers: you're credible and comfortable leading discovery, roadmap and strategy conversations with senior stakeholders at large organizations. Strong cross-functional partnership with Engineering and GTM teams (Marketing, Sales and Customer Success), and the ability to bring people along through change. Data-informed decision making: you use adoption metrics, customer behaviour and usage trends to set priorities, define success criteria and measure impact. Technical competency: you understand technical trade-offs well enough to have meaningful architecture and feasibility discussions with Engineering. Nice to haves Depth in AI, semantic web, knowledge graphs or data platforms (a strong plus): for example LLM or AI search products, schema.org and structured data, RDF or linked data, or data-platform and developer products. Experience with SEO, martech, content platforms or answer-engine optimization (AEO). Experience introducing or scaling product frameworks or a product community of practice across teams. Experience running customer-facing webinars, enablement or launch programs. A technical background (computer science or engineering degree, former engineer, solutions or analytics role). Startup or scale-up experience in an environment that needed more process and execution discipline. How we work / location This is a full-time, remote role. Schema App is headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, with a team across Canada. Schema App's Core Values Growth Mindset: You're curious, ambitious, and always looking for ways to improve, whether that's evolving how we build products, learning from customers and data, or experimenting with new AI and agentic tools. Resourceful: You turn ambiguity into action. You use data, customer insight, AI tools, and the expertise around you to make informed decisions and keep work moving, without waiting for perfect information or perfect conditions. One Team: Great products are built cross-functionally. You build strong partnerships with Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams, creating shared ownership of product decisions, launches, and outcomes. Humble: You bring strong product judgment without assuming you have all the answers. You listen to customers, users, and teammates, make your thinking transparent, and change course when what you learn points to a better path. Life @ Schema App Culture focused on your growth: Weekly 1:1 with conversations around Professional Development Great benefits for health & wellness, and your coverage starts as soon as you do RRSP matching! Flex days to re-energize on top of vacation days and you don't work on your birthday The Culture Club keeps our virtual team connected through fun and innovative events Diverse smart team! The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be Schema App's purpose is to build meaningful connections, with each other, our customers, and the data so that we are all understood. We are a team of smart people helping each other solve hard problems. AI-based tools may be used to support screening; all resumes are reviewed by a member of our team. If you require accommodation during the application process, please let us know. We are committed to an inclusive work environment and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives. Salary: $135,000 - $150,000 CAD DOE Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Are you passionate about building robust data architectures that power next-generation, AI-driven business intelligence? Do you thrive in the intersection of data engineering and analytics, wearing both hats to design scalable backends and deliver actionable insights? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analytics Manager - Business Intelligence & Data Architecture to join our Marketing Analytics team. In this role, you will work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Data Engineering teams to build the foundational "Gold Layers" and semantic models that enable self-serve reporting and agentic AI workflows. This is a great opportunity for a highly technical analyst who is hands-on with Python, Databricks, and SQL, and is excited about creating the infrastructure that enables AI for BI. If you’re energized by the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data pipelines and advanced analytical outputs, we’d love to hear from you. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. In this role, you will: Act as the bridge between Data Engineering and Marketing Analytics, designing, building, and maintaining robust ETL pipelines and "Gold Layer" tables in Databricks. Develop and document semantic layers, data dictionaries, and markdown files designed specifically to train and enable AI agents for scalable, self-serve BI. Develop dashboards and analyses to surface business-critical KPIs and assess sales and marketing performance. Perform ad-hoc reporting and deep dives to uncover key insights across programs and initiatives to inform strategy and decision making. Partner with marketing stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into scalable data models and analytics-ready datasets. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with experience in data analysis. Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate data transformation, analysis, and visualization workflows.
